**Finding: compliant (NOSOLICIT).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-inducement obligation on The Deerskin Companies (or on HDI). I checked every plausible home:

- **Section 5.4** (each Party appoints a General Manager) — the planner's leading candidate — is purely a liaison/authority provision with no restriction on approaching or hiring the other Party's staff.
- **Section 6 (Exclusivity)** restricts competing internet projects and "Deerskin" brand use, not personnel — a separate commercial issue outside this rule, so I have not flagged it here.
- Sections 1–4, 7 (Cross-Promotions), 8 (Confidentiality), 9 (Warranties) and 10 (General Provisions) contain no personnel covenant; targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "employees" returned no hits.
- Section 10.7 (Entire Agreement) confirms the document is the complete and exclusive bargain, so no such covenant is imported.

This satisfies the **preferred** position — "No non-solicit on Customer" — and benefits us, so no redline was proposed.
